summary: This Form 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Assembly Biosciences, Inc. registers a follow-on public offering of 3,358,602 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 415,000 shares at $26.50 per share (May 21 closing price), expected to raise approximately $94 million in net proceeds. The offering is an at-the-market, firm-commitment underwriting by Guggenheim Securities, UBS, Mizuho, and H.C. Wainwright. It is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle exists.
